test_title: PYST 69: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 27 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the pair that follows the same pattern as that followed by the two pairs given below. Both pairs follow the same pattern.

GKN−QUX

XBE−HLO
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b7bd91a6df65951f1b7f5e615b56c38bacd03202b3a56921b99da63b1060a77.png] 

Logic followed here is: First Letter + 10, Second Letter + 10, Third Letter + 10.

**For GKN : QUX →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0daf3f4b693e147a6246530afaefb629e97f4eb818b759300c6a7add4e0bee86.png] 

**For XBE : HLO →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8cae754aadf58e740742eb0e3e7f4cb35a99345a682c3e0498fb6a117d5e3026.png] 

**Similarly, Option 3) EIL : OSV:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99ab6c79bbd91f5718e282b901fabbe180b8a59b97b70fc9de2a8dd0b35c5f67.png] 

Therefore, the pair 'EIL−OSV' follows the same pattern.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
